title: Hafnia Supports 25 Newly Graduated Cadets at Regional Maritime University's 20th Graduation
summary: The Regional Maritime University (RMU) recently held its 20th Congregation graduation ceremony marking the end of years of study for hundreds of cadets. Hafnia’s ties with RMU date back to March 2023, when the two signed a Memorandum of Understanding to bring top cadets from West Africa aboard Hafnia vessels for their cadetships and first roles at sea. Since then, the partnership has grown through guest lectures, mentoring, and a steady pipeline of graduates joining the fleet.
